offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures gas detection instruments, respirators, head protection and fall protection gear, plus fire service helmets and breathing apparatus. Sold to industrial employers and fire departments, through direct and distributor channels.

primary_products.value: gas detectors; respirators; safety helmets; fall protection harnesses; self-contained breathing apparatus

primary_services.value: instrument calibration; gas detection monitoring; equipment testing and repair

customer_segment.value: B2B: industrial employers in oil and gas, mining, construction, chemicals and utilities; B2G: municipal and national fire departments and public safety agencies

end_markets.value: oil and gas; mining; fire service; construction; utilities; manufacturing

revenue_model.value: product sales: safety instruments, respirators, helmets and fire service gear; service fees: instrument calibration, testing and repair services

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: designs and makes detection and protection equipment from purchased components, sold to industrial and fire customers; brand owner: markets its own safety brands, some components sourced from outside suppliers; service provider: calibration and testing services sold to plant operators and fire departments
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; brand owner; service provider

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, Latin America and other regions

specialization.value: related lines: gas detection, respiratory protection, head and fall protection, and fire service gear sharing industrial safety customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: national industrial accounts and government fire service buyers; distributors / dealers: industrial safety distributors and fire equipment dealers; online: online ordering for replacement parts and consumables

regulatory_exposure.value: high: respirators and fire helmets need NIOSH and NFPA certification to be sold, and gas detectors need performance approvals

notes: Product mix and channels are described from general knowledge and may have changed.
